name: ancient-vscode
description: ANCIENT AI coding agent for VS Code using the same execution API as the terminal client.

commands.title: ANCIENT: Fix Current Diagnostics with ANCIENT

ancient.apiBaseUrl.description: ANCIENT v1 API base URL. Machine-scoped so a workspace cannot redirect credentialed requests.

ancient.apiKey.description: ANCIENT platform API key. Machine-scoped so workspace settings cannot redirect credentials.

ancient.model.description: Optional model id; empty uses the server default.

ancient.remoteWorkspaceRoot.description: Server-side workspace root used only when apiBaseUrl is remote. Required for remote execution and must map to the opened local workspace.

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external vscode
